title: Incorrect early return in parse_cookie
detail: When a cookie header is present, the function returns an empty ImmutableMultiDict instead of parsing the cookie string, so all cookies are lost.
note: Describes the planted negation: a cookie header that is present parses to nothing.

title: Potential UnicodeEncodeError when decoding cookie header
detail: If the cookie header contains characters outside latin‑1, `encode("latin1")` will raise a UnicodeEncodeError, causing a crash.

title: Incorrect file data handling
detail: The original code intended to skip processing when the file pointer is None. The change inverts the condition, causing all non‑None file pointers to be skipped and never read, leading to missing file data in multipart uploads.

title: add_class skips adding new classes
detail: The condition checks if the current classes already contain all new class names, and returns without adding. If the new classes are a subset of the existing ones, the method returns early, preventing any update. This can silently drop class additions that are not already present.

title: Breakpoint updates skipped when only one breakpoint list is present
detail: The _set_breakpoints method is now only called when both horizontal and vertical breakpoints are provided. If only one of the lists is non-empty, the method is never invoked, so breakpoint classes are never updated for that dimension. Existing callers expect updates for either dimension.

title: Condition inverted: should trigger on either breakpoint list
detail: The code only calls _set_breakpoints when both horizontal and vertical breakpoints are present, but the intended behavior is to update breakpoints whenever either list is non-empty.

title: Incorrect boundary check for previous word
detail: The code returns None when cword is 2, which incorrectly skips completion for the first argument after the executable. The original logic only skipped when cword < 2 or the previous word did not start with '-'.
note: Describes the planted `<=`: completion is skipped at `cword == 2`.

title: Return type does not allow None
detail: The function returns a ModuleType but callers expect it may return None when the module cannot be imported. This causes a type mismatch and potential runtime errors.
